title: Noxturn Recovery Intelligence Platform
subtitle: Live 2026
description:
Built a full stack recovery intelligence platform for rotating shift workers using Next.js 14, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, FastAPI, Supabase, and PostgreSQL, turning schedule, health, and wearable data into personalized recovery recommendations.
Built backend workflows powered by Claude Haiku, RAG based clinical retrieval, and a custom circadian risk engine to produce context aware 24 hour recovery plans and detect high risk shift patterns.
Integrated Fitbit OAuth and deployed the platform across web and API infrastructure, supporting secure wearable data ingestion, real time plan generation, and a production style end to end demo within hackathon timelines.

title: FaceFixer — AI Skincare Assistant
description: Built an AI-powered skincare assistant using YOLOv11 for face detection, integrated with a Spring Boot API, and deployed image storage on AWS S3.

title: Swiftiply — AI Reply Extension
description: Developed a privacy-first browser extension for Chrome/Firefox that generates context-aware replies using GPT API, built with TypeScript and React.

title: Urban Heat Island Analysis
description: Analyzed city-scale climate data to identify urban heat islands, using regression modeling, Pandas, and spatial data visualization dashboards.
